scripts.api:schema: uv run python apps/backend/manage.py spectacular --file packages/api-client/openapi.json --format openapi-json --validate --fail-on-warn
scripts.api:generate: corepack pnpm api:schema && corepack pnpm api:types
scripts.api:check: uv run python scripts/check_openapi.py && corepack pnpm --filter @ntu-events/api-client generated:check
scripts.format: uv run ruff format apps/backend src scripts tests && corepack pnpm exec prettier --write apps/web packages/api-client package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check apps/backend src scripts tests && corepack pnpm exec prettier --check apps/web packages/api-client package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .prettierrc.json
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check apps/backend src scripts tests && corepack pnpm -r --if-present lint
scripts.test: uv run pytest && corepack pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm django:check && corepack pnpm migrations:check && corepack pnpm api:check && corepack pnpm test
